artworks.title: Untitled (New York City)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Sharon Keim)
artworks.description: The image depicts a narrow urban alleyway flanked by tall buildings on both sides. The alley stretches into the distance, with a more illuminated area visible far ahead. The buildings create a tunnel-like effect, guiding the viewer's gaze. The photo has a grainy texture, giving it an atmospheric quality. The sepia tones create a vintage look, emphasizing shadow and light contrast. In the distance, faintly visible structures add depth to the urban environment.

artworks.title: Valley of the Yosemite from Mosquito Camp, No. 22
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase)
artworks.description: The image displays a tranquil river bordered by trees, extending to distant rugged mountains. The horizon features the mountains reflecting in the calm river running across the scene, with trees framing the view. The style appears photographic, emphasizing fine details and soft contrasts. The color palette is warm and sepia-toned, creating a nostalgic quality. Tree trunks and branches add texture, leading the eye to the meandering river reflecting the mountains and sky.

artworks.title: Cross Streets of New York
artworks.medium: pastel, watercolor, charcoal, and gouache on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Margaret M. Hitchcock through a Museum Exchange, 1975)
artworks.description: This painting shows a bustling narrow street. Tall tenements are on either side in shades of red and brown. Fire escapes and clothing hang from the sides of the buildings. The street below is covered in white snow. A couple in coats stands among other passersby, and horse-drawn cart is pulled down the street. In the background, the buildings converge at the end of the long street below an icy blue sky.

artworks.title: Portrait of Man, Harvard University
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Julia J. Norrell, 2007)
artworks.description: The image shows an oval-framed photograph of a man captured from the waist up. He is seated and facing the camera with a slight tilt to his left. The man has short, slightly curly hair and a neatly groomed beard. His facial features are defined, with a focused expression. He is wearing a textured dark suit with a waistcoat, white shirt, and a bow tie. He holds a hat in his left hand, which rests on his lap. The background is simple and undistracting, consisting of a plain light-colored surface.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Sharon Keim)
artworks.description: The image displays a coastal village situated on a sloping hillside. Small boats with the names "A.E.10," "S.F.B," and "WATER LILY" are lined up on the grass. The village consists of closely-packed houses with pitched roofs, varying in height due to the terrain. The houses have chimneys on their rooftops. A sandy beach bordered by rocky outcrops is visible in the distance, along with cliffs curving into the bay. The horizon where the sea meets the sky is depicted at the top of the image. The overall color scheme is in sepia tones, creating a vintage effect.

artworks.title: Portrait of Myself
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Joseph F. McCrindle Collection)
artworks.description: This is a pencil sketch portrait of a man facing forward with a neutral expression. He has a full beard, curly hair, and is wearing a collared garment. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Dear Edith
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Joseph F. McCrindle Collection)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of the upper half of a woman's body from the shoulders up. The woman is facing forward with a slight turn to her right. Her facial features include arched eyebrows, prominent eyes, a delicate nose, and a subtle mouth. She has curly hair partially covered by a hat with a bow and feathers. She wears a high-necked dress with shading around the collar. An earring peeks out from under her hair. The background is a plain, light-colored surface. There are artist signatures or annotations near the lower part of the image.

artworks.title: A Poem without Words
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, wash, and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Joseph F. McCrindle Collection)
artworks.description: The image shows flowing, curved lines and shapes creating an abstract composition. It features a chaotic cluster of human figures resembling cherubs or putti, some of which seem to fly or dance. These figures intersect with handwritten text, blending the appearance of an ink drawing with a handwritten letter. The overall effect is a whimsical, dreamlike scene where the figures appear engaged in playful activities.

artworks.title: "Yosemite Hotel"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Anonymous gift)
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene with a wooden hotel among tall trees. The view is from a riverbank, capturing the flow of the water. Two individuals are rowing a boat across the river. Mountains are faintly visible in the background, partly covered by foliage. The color palette is primarily in sepia tones. The focus is on the natural setting, with the hotel blending into the landscape.

artworks.title: Niagara Falls
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Paul Roth and Cyntia Karnes)
artworks.description: This image shows a wide waterfall with water flowing down in thick streams. The perspective is slightly elevated from the left side. The horizon is not clearly visible due to mist from the water. A treeline is visible above the falls. Closest to us, there is a boat with smoke coming from its stack moving through the waters. To the left, there is a structure with a long narrow roof extending towards the water, perhaps a dock or walk path. The color palette is mainly sepia tones, giving the image an antique, monochromatic look with variations in brown and cream, highlighting the texture of the water and the landscape.

artworks.title: Lena Lochiavo - 11 years old, basket (and pretzel) seller, at Sixth Street Market in front of saloon entrance, Cincinnati, Ohio
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Donna Barnard Ari)
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl seated beside a stack of baskets filled with pretzels. She is sitting on the sidewalk next to a large wooden post. The girl has dark hair, is wearing a dark-colored dress, and has a solemn expression on her face. Around her, several baskets and wooden crates are stacked. In the background, there is a small market stall where two men are standing, with one man blurred due to motion. The stall has large blocks or loaves on the table. The setting appears to be an urban area with multi-story buildings visible in the background, and the ground is paved with stone tiles.

artworks.title: Santa María Volcano, Quetzaltenango, Guatemala
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, by exchange: Duncan Phillips)
artworks.description: The image shows a mountainous landscape with rugged peaks against a slightly hazy sky. In the foreground, there is a man with a hat standing partially obscured by vegetation and rocks. The landscape includes textured fields, dense areas of trees, and mountains in the distance. The color palette is sepia tone, enhancing the contrast between the foliage and mountains.

artworks.title: Pictures from the Lava Beds, from "The Last of the Modocs," Harper's Weekly
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase)
artworks.description:
This image features scenes related to Modoc individuals and their environment during a conflict:

1. The top-left panel shows a figure aiming a rifle from behind rocks with the caption "MODOC BRAVE LYING IN WAIT FOR A SHOT."

2. The top-right panel depicts individuals behind rocky terrain marked "ON THE LOOK-OUT FOR AN ATTACK ON A PICKET STATION."

3. The middle panel shows a group resting against a rock and shelter titled "MODOC SQUAWS."

4. The bottom-left panel portrays individuals on a cliff edge overlooking rugged terrain with the caption "CAPTAIN JACK'S LATE STRONGHOLD."

5. The bottom-right panel shows a group peering from behind rocks named "WARM SPRING INDIANS SCOUTING." 

The overall theme is vigilance, resilience, and strategic occupation of geographical features under the caption "PICTURES FROM THE LAVA BEDS."

artworks.title: The Longshoremen's Noon
artworks.artist: Frederick Juengling, after John George Brown
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on thin wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Warren G. and Arlene S. Richman)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered in a dockside scene. The scene shows individuals sitting and standing amid barrels and sacks with the background dominated by masts and wooden structures of boats. Some individuals are seated in a circle on the ground, while others are resting or working. The foreground shows various objects like a tin can, a battered hat, and scattered pieces of paper.

artworks.title: Two Girls
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Bud Johns)
artworks.description: The image depicts two nude human figures in a domestic interior setting. One person is lying on a bed propped up slightly on an elbow in a reclining position, while the other is bent over, leaning toward the reclined person. Both individuals have dark hair tied back. The scene is set against a background of drapery or fabric, and there are no visible clothing, jewelry, or objects being held. The surroundings are dark and textured, enhancing the intimate scene depicted.

artworks.title: The Smithy
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Bud and Fran Moreland Johns)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist's studio. The scene captures a cluttered workspace filled with various art materials and furniture, such as easels, canvases, and tables covered with draped cloth. The space is lit by natural light coming through a large window on the left side, illuminating the wooden structures and casting soft shadows. The interior appears to be rustic, with visible beams supporting the ceiling. The sketchy lines and shading give a sense of texture and atmosphere, reflecting the busy and artistic ambiance of the studio.

artworks.title: The Tyresmith
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Bud and Fran Moreland Johns)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with figures in a passageway. The drawing depicts a dimly lit interior scene where several figures are distributed throughout a passageway. The scene features a colonnaded structure with visible beams on the ceiling and a tiled floor. The main figures stand in the foreground and mid-ground, each engaged in their actions or posed in conversation. The sketch is executed in soft, subtle pencil strokes, focusing more on the play of light and shadow than detailed textures.

artworks.title: The Old Smith's Story
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Bud and Fran Moreland Johns)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch featuring two male figures, depicting their upper bodies and faces turned slightly to the left of the image. One figure is seated while the other stands nearby. The figures have simple facial features and expressions, with one having a mustache and defined cheekbones. Their hair is sketched shortly, and they wear shirts with collars and possibly jackets. There are no distinct jewelry or objects visible. The background consists of dark charcoal strokes, creating an abstract setting. The sketch is monochromatic, using varying shades of grey and black.

artworks.title: The Smith's Yard
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Bud and Fran Moreland Johns)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stable scene with horses and figures. The drawing shows a rustic stable setting, with two horses in the foreground. The horses are sketched with soft lines, emphasizing their muscular structure. In the background, there are figures partially obscured by shadow. The structure of the stable is suggested with minimal lines. The drawing conveys a sense of calm and rural life through its simple line work.

artworks.title: Father and Son
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Bud and Fran Moreland Johns)
artworks.description: The sketch displays two figures from the waist up. The person on the left is slightly bent over, while the person on the right is leaning forward. The facial features are not detailed. Both figures wear hats and loose-fitting clothing. No specific jewelry or objects are shown. The background consists of indistinct lines and shading, hinting at a natural or outdoor setting. The scene focuses on the posture and gesture of the figures rather than specific details.

artworks.title: Henry Clay
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William Wilson Corcoran, 1879)
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a formal outfit and a calm expression.

artworks.title: Memorial Miniature
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of F.H. Calvert, 1935)
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a figure in mourning beside a memorial. The figure is leaning against a tombstone with an urn atop, surrounded by weeping willows. The tombstone is inscribed with a message— "Died 24 Jan, 1805 Aged 18 Months Blessed Spirit Rest in Peace". The willow branches frame the scene, and the figure's long dress and lowered gaze express contemplation and grief. The landscape features greenery under a serene sky, contributing to the somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: A. T. Kerr, Esquire
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Sarah A. Hagner, 1898)
artworks.description: The image shows a miniature portrait of a man's upper body. He is facing forward with his body slightly turned to the right. The man has fair skin, rounded cheeks, and light hair styled in waves away from his face. He wears a dark maroon coat over a white shirt with a white cravat. The portrait is in an oval gold-edged frame against a neutral gray background, suggesting a painted surface with delicate detail.

artworks.title: Marcia Burns
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Philip Hinkle, 1897)
artworks.description: The image is an oval miniature portrait. It shows the upper half of a woman's body, including her face and upper torso. She is facing slightly to her left, with curly dark hair framing her face and falling down her shoulders. The woman has light skin, arched eyebrows, and a gentle expression. She is wearing a white dress with detailed ruffling along the neckline. There are no visible jewelry or objects in her hands. The background is a gradient of light to darker blue. The portrait is encased in an oval frame with a loop at the top for hanging. The artist's initials and the year "1793" are inscribed on the painting next to her shoulder.
